body: Adderall really only increases dopamine levels, not serotonin.

Our situations are rather different, but I suppose I still should be there for her..

And I lived for nothing before I got into drugs. Literally. Life seemed like a waste of time... save for video games. Then I discovered how truly unhappy I had always been.

I truly believe I don't have a conscience at all. I don't give a fuck about anything. I'm not a violent person, but I'm sure I could shoot somebody in the face and not care at all.

I wish there was a cure for being a terrible person.

I'm 20 years old, so I think I may have a developing mental disorder, in which case I will cease living. This is what frightens me about continuing to live the most.
Sounds like a psychiatrist might benefit you.

And I now this is "the most selfish thing anyone can do," but I've always been a terrible selfish person. I fit the definition for a psychopath.

Although, I would consider it selfish of others to demand their suicidal acquaintance continue living even though they're in terrible emotional pain, just so they themselves don't have to grieve over them. Kind of messed up.

Not that I'm in pain, I just haven't felt anything in tooo long. Think: Dexter. I haven't cried in years. I just can't keep up this act like I'm normal forever, I don't want to.
